lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized into approximately seven visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Centroid size appears relatively uniform with slight increase in diameter toward the ventral-lateral transition.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with spot clusters, forming a grid-like configuration most prominent in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal ridge feature in the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular high-luminance patch located on the dorsal ridge above the mid-flank, consistent with an abrasion or depigmented scar. Visible indentation or irregular texture in the dermal layer posterior to the fifth gill slit.
